overview: In FRM-like/1, halleyCubic initializes z from pixel and replaces very small |z| with (0.00001,0). The loop builds f, fp, fpp, and denom; it keeps z when denom has squared size below 1e-10, otherwise computes numer and assigns z - numer/denom. The pinned julia profile uses 96 iterations.
mathSummary: starts z from pixel; if |z| < 0.00001, sets z to (0.00001,0); repeatedly builds z2, z3, f, fp, fpp, and denom = 2*(fp*fp)-f*fpp, then keeps z when denom has squared size below 1e-10 or assigns z - numer/denom with numer = 2*(f*fp); bailout is |z - zPrev| >= 0.000001.

sourceWalkthrough.explanation: Initialization: init/0 sets z from pixel.
Iteration: loop/0 sets z2 = z*z; later loop nodes build f, fp, fpp, and denom.
Branch: loop/6 keeps z when denom has squared size below 1e-10; otherwise its else path computes numer and assigns z - numer/denom.

steps: Use the pinned julia profile with all controls fixed. Run 48 iterations and then 96 iterations, and record whether the denom guard or the z - numer/denom update changes the observed iteration counts.
